hero.headline: Say what matters — anonymously or in your name
hero.support: A corporate trust box for ideas, questions, and signals. Quiet by design, respectful of your privacy.

how.title: How it works
how.subtitle: Three short steps from thought to message.

choose.title: Pick a topic and recipient
choose.body: Choose what it’s about and who should hear it — or leave the recipient open.

write.title: Write your message
write.body: Describe the situation in your own words. Stay anonymous or add a contact.

send.title: Send securely
send.body: Messages travel through a protected channel. Recipients see the content — not your technical trail.

privacy.title: Privacy by default
privacy.body: Anonymous submissions need no name or email. Only authorized admins can read feedback. Writes are protected by Firestore rules and a corporate Google account.

topics.title: What you can write about
topics.subtitle: Any topic that affects work and team culture.

feedback.title: Your message
feedback.subtitle: Two steps — and your feedback is ready to send.

reviews.title: Replies

message.label: Message
message.placeholder: Describe the situation as specifically as you can…

form.allowPublicReply: Allow an admin to publish the reply in the on-site reviews section (without your name if anonymous).

success.title: Thank you — feedback sent
success.body: We received your message. If you left a contact, a reply will go to that email.
